# Chase Golden Globe

> Chase Golden Globe is a private investment house founded in 2006 by Fouad Barhoum, headquartered in Sydney, Australia. It began by exporting fine furniture out of Indonesia to furnish hotels, restaurants and private homes worldwide, and has since grown into an investment house connecting investors to projects across nine countries: Australia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Algeria, Egypt, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, and Luxembourg.

Chase Golden Globe's founder, Fouad Barhoum, built an international network through the furniture export business and went on to complete courses in finance, risk assessment and financial analysis. He now works as a connector between investors and projects, handling due diligence, investor reporting and pitch preparation. Core capabilities include structured project and export finance, capital structuring and risk, impact and sustainable investment, government and institutional liaising, bankability and project readiness advisory, capital raising, mergers and acquisitions, private equity advisory, and joint ventures and strategic alliances. The house serves agriculture and food security, energy, infrastructure, retail and hospitality, industrial manufacturing, and cross-border trade connecting Africa, the Middle East and Asia.

## Notes

- Founder: Fouad Barhoum.
- Founded: 2006.
- Headquarters: Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.
- Contact email: info@chasegoldenglobe.com.au
- Licensing: Chase Golden Globe is not itself a licensed financial services provider. Regulated activities are delivered in partnership with appropriately licensed practitioners and firms. See the Legal & Privacy page.
